prompt: Coal burned in power stations began, hundreds of millions of years ago, as what?

options.text: Ancient sea shells crushed under the ocean floor
Ancient plants buried in swamps and compressed over time
Dinosaur bones and remains buried in deserts

explanation: Coal formed mainly from lush swamp plants of the Carboniferous period, buried before they could fully rot and transformed by heat and pressure.
